title: Is This AI Feature Documented? Recognizing Categories from Lists of Names
question: An example of such a feature in action: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars -> Planets Sirius, Antares, Regulus, Aldebaran -> Stars Izanami, Izanagi, Amaterasu, Susanoo -> Japanese gods Titan, Hyperion, Dione, Prometheus -> Moons of Saturn The pattern followed is this "names" -> "named group". Is this documented on research? (This may not be a gen AI feature however). Bonus if it supports RAG with web search.
answer: The task itself predates the recent GenAI boom and has been studied under names such as entity set labeling, common hypernym discovery, and cluster/topic labeling.
